subject: [PATCH v6 19/19] selftests/mm: zap whole PTE tables in the khugepaged race harness

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged race harness to occasionally zap whole PMD-aligned areas of page tables, rather than just individual pages. This is done to simulate a racing condition between the MADV_DONTNEED thread and the collapse walking the same table. The change aims to improve the test's ability to detect potential issues related to page table reclaiming.
